notes: A double scan at a support computer no longer checks the student straight back out: a bouncy scanner or a second pull of the trigger at a support recorded a check-in and a check-out (BUG-109).
Support computers keep up even if the main computer's clock was once set wrong: one record stamped in the future stopped them receiving new check-ins for hours (BUG-110).
Undo works on the first tap right after a scan, while the check-in stamp is still showing (BUG-111).
Staff punches reach support computers once each: a few were being saved twice (BUG-112).
Undo at a support computer takes back the right student: pressed a moment after a scan, it could take back the student before (BUG-113).
Support computers get every automatic check-out: one closing out a visit from an earlier day could miss them until they restarted (BUG-114).
Checked and working at this size: start-up, every screen, backups, the two-year log, payroll and overtime against an independent calculation, and the Florida rules for staff under 18.
how: Shahien will send you the new installer. Install it over the old one; your records stay as they are.
